estimates: The heritage survey supplies the chimney height. The width fitted within the marked base, top width, stepped cornice details and the small inspection aperture are estimates.
Only the visible crown of the inclined flue and exposed base are represented. The exact exterior exposure of the brick conduit and its connection into the pumping station are approximate.
The original 5 m terrain is preserved. The ground can obscure individual brick steps and local foundation joints.

review.notes: Checked the Qualla image inventory first. The exact chimney photo uses an attribution license. The reconstruction uses the official geographic boundary, original ground elevations and factual survey dimensions. No image bytes or survey drawings are used.
